description: Read a public audiobook's bilingual text: its sentence pairs (each original sentence with its translation, plus a Latin-script romanization for languages that have one), in reading order. Returns at most `limit` pairs starting at `offset`; continue with offset + limit while has_more is true. total_pairs is the book's length.

book_id.description: The book's id (the `id` field of a Book).
book_id.title: Book Id

limit.description: Maximum number of sentence pairs to return.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Index of the first sentence pair to return.
offset.title: Offset

name: read_book

Segment.description: One stretch of the book's audio speaking one side of a sentence pair.

end_ms.description: Offset where it ends, in milliseconds.
end_ms.title: End Ms

role.description: Which side of a sentence pair an audio segment speaks. Known values: source, target. New values may be added within v1; treat an unknown one as unrecognised, not as an error.
role.title: Role

start_ms.description: Offset into the book's audio where the segment starts, in milliseconds.
start_ms.title: Start Ms

words.description: Word-level timings, when the speech provider supplied them.
words.title: Words

Segment.title: Segment

TextPair.description: One sentence of the original text with its translation.

index.description: Position of the pair in the book, starting at 0.
index.title: Index

romanization.description: Latin-script transliteration of target_text (e.g. pinyin), for languages that have one.
romanization.title: Romanization

segments.description: The pair's audio segments, in playback order. Present only when timings were requested.
segments.title: Segments

source_text.description: The sentence in the source language.
source_text.title: Source Text

target_text.description: Its translation in the target language.
target_text.title: Target Text

TextPair.title: TextPair

Word.description: One word of a segment, with the moment it starts being spoken.

start_ms.description: Offset into the book's audio, in milliseconds.
start_ms.title: Start Ms

Word.title: Word

outputSchema.description: A window of a book's bilingual text, in reading order.

has_more.description: Whether pairs exist after this window.
has_more.title: Has More

limit.description: Maximum number of pairs in this window.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Index of the first pair in this window.
offset.title: Offset

total_pairs.description: Number of sentence pairs in the whole book.
total_pairs.title: Total Pairs

outputSchema.title: BookText

title: Read an audiobook's text
